expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card sits about 28px lower than its neighbors. Its image, time badge, title and delivery fee are all offset downward, so the row looks jagged compared to the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria cards.

The favorite (heart) buttons in 'Popular right now' are inconsistent. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart is a bare white icon with no background. On the pizza card below, the same button has a dark circular backdrop.

The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail looks faded and low-contrast compared to the other carousel images, as if it has reduced opacity or a disabled/loading overlay. This could make the restaurant look unavailable.
